hero_kpi_rationale: The Proprietary Products segment is the primary driver of growth and margin, capturing demand for advanced delivery systems and integrated solutions for biologic therapies, making it the key KPI to assess strategic performance.

kpis.explanation_en: Revenue generated from the sale of exclusive products such as advanced injection and packaging systems.
kpis.description: The Proprietary Products segment is strategic, featuring high-value-added products such as connected auto-injection devices.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by demand for biologic therapies and auto-injection

kpis.explanation_en: Revenue from custom manufacturing of complex devices for pharmaceutical clients.
kpis.description: This segment depends on one-off orders and client development projects. Total revenue of 3,074.1 M$ is split between Proprietary Products (~2,100 M$) and Contract-Manufactured Products (~974 M$).
kpis.signal: Moderate growth linked to client production cycles

kpis.explanation_en: Difference between sales and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin (1,104.0 / 3,074.1 = 35.9%) improves due to better absorption of fixed costs and a product mix favoring premium products.

kpis.explanation_en: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improves to 19.0% in 2025 (584.9 / 3,074.1), despite restructuring charges of 23.3 M$.
kpis.signal: Marginal improvement due to controlled restructuring expenses

kpis.explanation_en: R&D expenses divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: R&D (74.3 M$ / 3,074.1 M$ = 2.4%) focuses on auto-injection devices, formulations, and integrated systems.
kpis.signal: Targeted investment in advanced injection systems

kpis.explanation_en: Spending on physical assets such as factories and equipment.
kpis.description: Capex supports capacity expansion to meet growing demand for delivery systems.
kpis.signal: Capex increasing to modernize production capabilities

kpis.explanation_en: One-time costs related to organizational restructuring programs, including personnel and facility closure costs.
kpis.description: In 2025, restructuring charges reach 23.3 M$ (18.4 M$ in operating charges for severance, accelerated depreciation, and lease costs + 4.9 M$ in professional fees for legal restructuring) versus 2.1 M$ in 2024, reflecting the January 2025 restructuring plan and legal structure optimizations.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in restructuring charges in 2025 due to reorganizations

kpis.explanation_en: Operating result adjusted for non-recurring items (restructuring, disposal losses, other exceptional charges).
kpis.description: Adjusted operating profit increases by 8.7% (from 572.8 M$ in 2024 to 622.4 M$ in 2025) despite macro challenges, driven by Proprietary Products sales momentum (+8%) and strict cost management.
kpis.signal: Robust growth in adjusted operating profitability excluding exceptional items

kpis.explanation_en: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares over the fiscal year. Indicates the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for calculating the Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks (ransomware, intrusions, data loss, insider threats, malicious attacks), but has implemented an incident response plan and layered security controls to mitigate them.
risks.score_rationale: The company has implemented a cybersecurity risk management plan based on the COSO ERM framework and NIST standards, with a comprehensive cybersecurity program led by the VP Digital Transformation and Cybersecurity. However, a security breach could have severe consequences on critical operations related to the manufacturing of injectable delivery systems.

risks.title: Litigation and Regulatory Compliance
risks.summary: The company faces potential litigation risks and strict FDA/EMA regulatory compliance requirements that could negatively impact its business.
risks.score_rationale: Legal risk inherent in operating within the highly regulated medical device and pharmaceutical sector. Potential litigation could affect the company's finances and reputation.

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: The company must maintain its technological and quality advantage to remain a leader in the competitive injectable delivery systems sector.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market for containment and delivery systems for injectable drugs, with established players and potential new entrants. Increased competition could pressure margins.
